text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy expressed her determination. 
She vowed to run in a way that would 
surely defeat Symboli Kris S and leave her 
craving a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Though Symboli Kris S had announced her 
retirement, her strength remained as 
formidable as ever.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
At Nakayama at the year's end, the battle 
to determine the Grand Prix champion 
begins.
